method: UI pages and forms opened and read; every form cancelled; API GET only. Token, project, and version counts were unchanged afterwards. Registration key not read.

findings.observed: Phase defaults to 'In Planning' on Create Standard Project and on an existing project's Create Version dialog (UI-created projects and versions).
Distribution defaults to 'External' on both forms (UI-created projects and versions).

Admin > System Settings > Product Registration shows the registration's limits (codebase size, scan size per scan, versions per project where limited), license features, and licensed modules. Limits vary by registration; this record does not keep the sandbox's values.

GET /api/roles descriptions match the role matrix: Global Project Administrator can create, modify, and delete projects and versions; Global Project Manager description does not mention create; Project Creator can create projects and becomes Project Manager on them.
findings.not_checked: Effective permissions. Needs sessions as users holding each role and a create attempt (a write action).

open_checks: Do projects and versions created or mapped by Detect CLI, without --detect.project.version.phase or --detect.project.version.distribution, get the same In Planning and External defaults as the UI?

review.notes: Token-path result is recorded in live-2026-09-27-access-token-location. Approval Status defaulting to Unreviewed was observed but deliberately not made a case: low customer value, and it is easily changed after creation. sca-role-001 recorded as partial by agent recommendation.
